main_text.l: Mendacia Patriarcharum Augustinus extenuat 1.3.20. mendacia simpliciter interdicta 1.6.23. mendacium quid 1.8.26. eius species tres.ib. perniciosum, iocosum 1.8.9.26. officiosum quod etiā vetatur 1.10.28. eo vita nostra redimenda nō est.ib. nec aliena 1.11.29. mendax periurus cito fiet.ibid. mendaciorum noua species & defensiones 1.13.14.32. & seqq. regula Sacrificorum pro mendaciis 1.17.39. mentiri minime licet in diuinis 1.19.42. mendacia haec noua Nauarrus ex consequenti eruerit 1.23.49. mentiri non magis licet alterius causa, quam scortari. 1.24.52
